consistency: Eventual query visibility; exact selected values and complete logical IDs after queues drain and publication is fenced
batch_atomicity: not-supported; any partial OTLP response leaves the source batch unacknowledged/ambiguous
source_retry: none; preserve intent and response journal
collector_retry: at-least-once; persistent exporter queue with fsync, 1s initial/5s maximum backoff and unlimited elapsed retry
idempotency: Native metric timestamp/key behavior; append-only log/span replays may duplicate. No universal retry-safe mutation claim.
ttl: Native retained-storage policies are configured where supported; deletion/physical reclamation is unqualified here
timestamp_common_subset: Millisecond log/metric and microsecond-aligned span timestamps; physical clock and arbitrary nanosecond preservation unqualified

victoria.durability: native buffered admission, no synchronous ACK equivalence

grafana.durability: native WAL/default flush policies, to be observed; not assumed synchronous
grafana.tempo_mode: monolithic local development storage; no Kafka

visibility_observation.trace_id_lookup: Eventual; VictoriaTraces default trace-index flush interval is 20 seconds. Retain an acknowledged sample until it is observed rather than replacing it at 10 seconds.
visibility_observation.claim: The diagnostic age threshold is not an immediate-read consistency or durability SLA.
